title: CYP Induction, Part 1/3: Wash
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file to your computer and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the required labware files with .json extensions.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware

steps.title: Upload .py file to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol script file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck layout according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette as described in the calibration guide.

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press the Run button to start the protocol.
